reasons.plausibility: The proposed mechanism aligns well with known oxidation behaviors of Al- and Si-containing alloys versus Mn-containing counterparts, making it scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: Measuring oxidation kinetics and scale adhesion in systematically varied Alloys (X = Al, Si, Mn) under controlled high-temperature conditions enables a clear, decisive test of the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Demonstrating how specific elements influence oxide stability guides alloy design for high-temperature corrosion resistance, making this hypothesis highly relevant for HEA research.
